subject: Charged twice for order ORD-3310
body: I was charged TWICE for order ORD-3310 — $128.40 on my card, twice, same day. This is unacceptable. I want one of those charges refunded immediately.

subject: Refund window question
body: Hi, I bought a jacket last week but it does not fit. Am I still inside the refund window if I return it on day 28?

subject: Service down for 3 days — want a refund
body: Your API has been failing for three days and my integration is completely offline. I have lost billable hours. I want a full refund for this month or at least a substantial credit.

subject: How long do refunds take?
body: I returned an order last Tuesday and got an email saying the refund was processed. How many days until it shows up on my statement?

subject: Price hike refund for annual plan
body: I subscribed to the annual plan in June at $199. You just announced the price is going to $259. I want a full refund of my annual plan immediately — I never agreed to this.

subject: Refund received — how long to post?
body: Just wanted to say the refund went through, thank you for sorting it so fast. Quick question — how long does it usually take to appear on the card statement?

subject: Damaged item — demanding $75 compensation
body: The mirror I ordered arrived with a cracked frame. I want $75 back for the inconvenience plus a replacement. The order total was $75 so a partial refund of $75 is fair.

subject: Where is my refund for ORD-5521?
body: I returned order ORD-5521 over a week ago and still see no refund. Can you check the status for me and tell me where it is?

subject: Android app crash loop on 3.2.0
body: After updating to Android app 3.2.0 the app crashes on launch every single time. I lost two unsaved drafts and I cannot get in at all. Fix this now.

subject: Payment failed with error 4032
body: I am trying to check out but payment keeps failing with Error Code 4032. My card works everywhere else. What does 4032 mean and how do I fix it?

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: I requested a password reset three times and no email has arrived. I have checked spam and promotions. Please help me get back into my account.

subject: CSV export empty when names contain accents
body: When I export contacts to CSV and any name contains an accent (like Jose or Zoe), the whole file comes back empty. Reproduced it four times with different accounts.

subject: Dashboard shows error 5001
body: As soon as I log in the dashboard renders Error 5001 and nothing loads. I have tried two browsers. This started this morning.

subject: Monthly report numbers are wrong
body: The September revenue report shows $41,200 but our payment processor says $47,800. We are making financial decisions on this data. The numbers must be corrected and explained today.

subject: Dark mode toggle resets
body: I turn on dark mode, it works, then it reverts to light mode after I close the tab. Minor annoyance but it happens every time.

subject: Photo uploads fail over 5MB
body: Uploading product photos larger than 5MB always fails silently — no error, the spinner just stops. Smaller photos work fine. Is there a size limit?

subject: Typo on pricing page
body: Small thing — the pricing page says 'Unlimted bandwidth' in the second feature card. Love the product otherwise!

subject: API returns 401 after token refresh
body: Our integration refreshes the OAuth token but every subsequent call returns 401. The refresh call itself returns 200. We are using the v2 endpoints.

subject: Order stuck in transit + return policy
body: My order has shown 'in transit' for 8 days with no scan updates. Where is it? Also, what is your return window — I may just refuse delivery if it arrives late.

subject: Package lost — wedding Saturday
body: Tracking has not updated in 6 days and the package is supposed to contain my bridesmaid dresses. The wedding is THIS Saturday. I need this today, not tomorrow.

subject: Do you ship to Canada?
body: Do you ship to Toronto, Canada? If yes, how long does delivery take and is there a customs deposit?

subject: Change delivery address for ORD-6102
body: I placed order ORD-6102 an hour ago to my old address. I have moved. Can you change the delivery address to my new place before it ships?

subject: Received wrong item
body: I ordered the navy blue running shoes and received black boots instead. Order ORD-4417. How do I return this and get the right item?

subject: Expedited shipping options?
body: I need an order by next Wednesday. What expedited shipping options do you offer and what does each one cost?

subject: Third late delivery — compensation please
body: This is the THIRD order in a row arriving late. I have paid for shipping every time. I want compensation for all three orders or I am done shopping with you.

subject: Delivered early — thanks!
body: My order arrived two days early and everything was packed perfectly. Just wanted to say great job to your logistics team.

subject: VAT number missing on invoice
body: Invoice INV-8841 does not include our VAT number so I cannot reclaim the tax. Can you reissue the invoice with our VAT ID IT00743110968?

subject: Charged after cancelling
body: I cancelled my subscription last week and you still charged my card $29 today. Cancel means cancel. Refund this charge.

subject: Upgrade mid-cycle proration
body: I am on the Starter plan halfway through the month and want to upgrade to Pro. Will I be charged for a full month or only the remaining 15 days?

subject: Update card on file
body: My company card was replaced and I need to update the card on file before the next billing date on October 1. What is the process?

subject: Terminate contract — 12 seats refund
body: We are terminating our 12-seat contract effective immediately due to repeated outages. That is $2,868 remaining on the term. I expect a full refund wired within 10 business days.

subject: Where do I download invoices?
body: My accountant needs all invoices for the last fiscal year. Where in the app can I download them — and can I get them as a batch ZIP?

subject: PayPal payment support?
body: Do you accept PayPal yet? All my team cards are locked to one vendor and PayPal would be much easier for us.

subject: Reset my password
body: I changed laptops and cannot remember my password. Please reset it so I can get back in.

subject: Locked out after failed attempts
body: My daughter tried my password a few times and now the account says locked. I have a client call in an hour and cannot get in. Please unlock it urgently.

subject: Merge two accounts
body: I accidentally created two accounts with different emails — C-1361 and a personal one. All my orders are split across them. Can you merge them into one?

subject: Delete all my data immediately
body: Under GDPR I am exercising my right to erasure. Delete every record you hold on me — account, orders, analytics — permanently. Confirm in writing when done.

subject: Change account email address
body: I got married and my email changed from the old maiden-name address. How do I change the email on my account?

subject: Set up two-factor authentication
body: I would like to enable two-factor authentication on my account. Do you support authenticator apps or only SMS?

subject: Please add dark mode to mobile
body: Dark mode on the web is great. When is it coming to the iOS and Android apps? I read in bed every night and the white screen is blinding.

subject: Slack integration
body: Every tool we use posts updates to Slack except yours. An official Slack integration would save us from checking the dashboard 20 times a day. Any plans?

subject: Bulk export API endpoint
body: We need to export 50k records nightly to our warehouse. Is there a bulk export endpoint, or can we paginate faster than 100 records per request?

subject: Keyboard shortcuts + praise
body: Your editor is the best I have used. Two requests: does it support keyboard shortcuts like Cmd+K, and if not please add them — my hands never leave the keyboard.

subject: Add SSO or we cancel
body: We have asked for SAML SSO three times. It is a hard requirement from our security team. If it is not on your roadmap with a date this quarter, we are cancelling all 40 seats.

subject: Order status + return policy
body: Where is order ORD-7788? Tracking has not moved in 4 days. Also, what is your return policy if it arrives damaged?

subject: Partnership inquiry
body: I run a logistics marketplace with 12,000 merchants and we would like to explore a white-label partnership. Who should I speak with about commercial terms?

subject: 45 min wait + refund demand
body: I waited 45 minutes for a human and got disconnected twice. Your support is a joke. I want a refund for this month's subscription AND a manager to call me.

subject: Do you sell my data?
body: Before I upload my contacts, I need to know — do you sell or share my data with third parties or advertisers? Yes or no, please.

subject: Loyalty discount for renewal
body: My annual renewal is coming up and budget is tight this year. Do you offer any loyalty or renewal discounts for existing customers?

subject: Chargeback filed — services not rendered
body: I have filed a chargeback with my bank for services not rendered. Consider this formal notice. If you contact me again before resolving it, I will escalate to my attorney.
